channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: The strike that changed the geometry of war
item.description: Israel's attacks on Doha and Tehran demonstrate a new capability that may make warfare more unpredictable.

item.title: At least four killed in Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia
item.description: Russian authorities say three people killed in the Moscow region and one in Belgorod in Ukrainian attacks.

item.title: Al Jazeera reports from Strait of Hormuz on Iran’s plan to manage shipping
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Tohid Asadi reports from the strait and explains Tehran’s newest plan to manage shipping.

item.title: Sardar Azmoun left out as Iran announce World Cup 2026 squad
item.description: Veteran striker Azmoun was not named in the 30-man squad, which will be trimmed to 26 by June 1.

item.title: Iran war day 79: Tehran to unveil Hormuz toll plan; Israel bombs Lebanon
item.description: Iran says it will soon reveal the plan as Trump warns Tehran it will have a 'very bad time' if deal not reached soon.

item.title: FIFA holds ‘positive’ talks with Iranian football officials on World Cup
item.description: FIFA offers solutions for each of Iran's concerns before games in US, Iran's football chief says.

item.title: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a global health emergency
item.description: The agency added that the outbreak, with around 246 cases and 80 deaths, does not meet the criteria of pandemic emergency.

item.title: Hezbollah drone strike videos show evolving tactics against Israel
item.description: BBC Verify has examined dozens of videos of fibre-optic drone attacks carried out by the Lebanese armed group.

item.title: Senior IS leader killed in joint operation, US and Nigeria say
item.description: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

item.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
item.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.
